Agent skills contain instructions, and sometimes scripts, that your agent may run with your permissions. Bundled skills come from the [sugatoray/aiskills](https://github.com/sugatoray/aiskills) repo at the version you installed; you can read them in `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills/`. External skills are third-party code: prefer `owner/repo@skill` from sources you trust.

## Telemetry

`aiskills` sends nothing. The `skills` CLI sends anonymous usage data to `skills.sh` unless `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` is set; `aiskills` passes both through.

See also: [Errors and exit codes](../reference/errors.md) · [Choose the `skills` CLI version](../guides/choose-the-skills-cli-version.md)

<!-- source: reference/cli.md -->
# CLI reference

Every command, alias and option of `aiskills`, `ais` and `aix`; this page is exhaustive.

```text
aiskills <command> [options] [-- <extra npx skills arguments>]
```

- **`aiskills`** and **`ais`** are the same command.
- **`aix`** is `aiskills --route`: `aix i -s pdf` = `aiskills --route install -s pdf`.
- With no command, `aiskills` runs `install`.
- `--route`, `--nested` and `--flat` can also go **before** the command: `aiskills --route installed`, `aiskills --nested` (= `install --nested`).
- Options are checked per command. An option a command doesn't take fails with `option <x> is not valid here`.

## Commands

| Command | Aliases | Does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`install`](#install) | `i` | Save the skills and run `npx skills add` on them (the default command) |
| [`uninstall`](#uninstall) | `r`, `rm`, `remove` | Remove skills with `npx skills remove` |
| [`installed`](#installed) | `ls` | Show installed skills |
| [`groups`](#groups) | `g` | List the skill groups |
| [`find`](#find) | `f` | Search the skills registry |
| [`sync`](#sync) | | Only save or refresh the skills folder |
| [`list`](#list) | | List the skills in the saved folder, via `npx skills` |
| [`path`](#path) | `p` | Print the install folder |
| [`skills`](#skills) | | Pass arguments to `npx skills` |
| [`help`](#help) | `h`, `-h`, `--help` | Show the help |
| [`-v`, `--version`](#-v---version) | | Print the version |

`sync`, `skills` and `list` have no one-letter alias on purpose: `s` would be ambiguous, and `l` looks like `ls`.

### `install`

Save the skills to the install folder (see [`sync`](#sync)), then run `npx skills add <install folder>` with the selected skills and agents.

```text
aiskills install [-g|-p] [-a agents] [-s skills] [-G groups] [--copy] [--route] [--nested|--flat] [-- <extra>]
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Alias | `i` |
| Options | [`-g`](#-g---global), [`-p`](#-p---project), [`-a`](#-a---agent), [`-s`](#-s---skill), [`-G`](#-g---group---groups), [`--copy`](#--copy), [`--route`](#--route), [`--nested`](#--nested), [`--flat`](#--flat), [`--`](#--) |
| Default | Every skill, `--global`, agents detected by `npx skills` |
| Exit code | `1` if a name, pattern or lookup fails (nothing is installed); otherwise the exit code of `npx skills add` |

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills install
```

```text
[aiskills] skills saved to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (flat layout)
[aiskills] running: npx -y skills@1.7.6 add ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills --global --skill '*' --yes
```

With `-s`/`-G`, it prints `bundled: <names>` first. With `--route`, names that aren't bundled are looked up and installed after the bundled ones (`external: <spec>`).

See: [1. Install a group](../tutorial/01-install-a-group.md) · [2. Pick skills and agents](../tutorial/02-pick-skills-and-agents.md)

### `uninstall`

Remove skills with `npx skills remove <names> --yes`.

```text
aiskills uninstall [-g|-p] [-a agents] [-s skills] [-G groups] [--route] [--purge] [-f] [-n] [-- <extra>]
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Aliases | `r`, `rm`, `remove` |
| Options | [`-g`](#-g---global), [`-p`](#-p---project), [`-a`](#-a---agent), [`-s`](#-s---skill), [`-G`](#-g---group---groups), [`--route`](#--route), [`--purge`](#--purge), [`-f`](#-f---force), [`-n`](#-n---dry-run), [`--`](#--) |
| Default | A **full uninstall**: every skill `npx skills list --json` reports as installed from the install folder |
| Exit code | `1` on a refused name or option; otherwise the exit code of `npx skills remove` (`0` if there was nothing to remove) |

- **Full** (no `-s`/`-G`): removes exactly the skills recorded as installed from the install folder, even with `--route`. If `npx skills list` can't be read, it falls back to every skill in the folder, with a warning.
- **Partial** (`-s`/`-G`): names this package doesn't provide are refused, unless `--route` or `-f`. Skills reached through a pattern or group are removed only if installed.
- **`-a`** removes the skills from those agents only.
- The skill files stay in the install folder unless `--purge`.

<!-- verify: list=prodigy,stata-recipes -->
```bash
aiskills uninstall -G stata -n
```

```text
[aiskills] [dry-run] would remove (global): stata-recipes
[aiskills] [dry-run] npx -y skills@1.7.6 remove stata-recipes --global --yes
```

See: [5. Uninstall](../tutorial/05-uninstall.md) · [Remove everything](../guides/remove-everything.md)

### `installed`

List the skills `npx skills` reports as installed from the install folder, one per line: name, group, agents.

```text
aiskills installed [-g|-p] [--route]
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Alias | `ls` |
| Options | [`-g`](#-g---global), [`-p`](#-p---project), [`--route`](#--route) (all skills, with a source column) |
| Exit code | `1` if `npx skills list` can't be read |

<!-- verify: list=scrolls-setup,newsletter-ai -->
```bash
aiskills ls
```

```text
newsletter-ai              -                      Claude Code
scrolls-setup              scrolls-skills         Claude Code
```

A `-` in the group column means the skill belongs to no group.

### `groups`

List the skill groups from the bundled `marketplace.json`, with their aliases and skills, and the skills in no group. Syncs the install folder first, quietly.

```text
aiskills groups [--json]
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Alias | `g` |
| Options | [`--json`](#--json) |

Output: see [1. Install a group](../tutorial/01-install-a-group.md#see-the-groups); JSON shape: [Files and schemas](files.md#aiskills-groups---json).

### `find`

Search the skills registry: `aiskills find <query>` runs `npx skills find <query>`. Every argument is passed on.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Alias | `f` |
| Exit code | The exit code of `npx skills find` |

### `sync`

Save or refresh `<install folder>/skills/` from the package, without running `npx skills add`. Also writes `marketplace.json`, `layout.json` and `aiskills.json` next to it.

```text
aiskills sync [--nested|--flat]
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Options | [`--nested`](#--nested), [`--flat`](#--flat) |

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills sync
```

```text
[aiskills] skills saved to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (flat layout)
```

### `list`

Sync, then run `npx skills add <install folder> --list`, which lists the skills there without installing them. Takes no options.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills list
```

```text
[aiskills] skills saved to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (flat layout)
[aiskills] running: npx -y skills@1.7.6 add ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills --list
```

### `path`

Print the install folder: `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills`, or `AISKILLS_HOME` if set. Changes nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Alias | `p` |

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills p
```

```text
~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills
```

### `skills`

Run `npx -y skills@<pinned version> <args>` with every argument unchanged, except that `:root` is replaced by the install folder. Exit code: that of `npx skills`.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills skills remove prodigy -a codex -g -y
```

```text
[aiskills] running: npx -y skills@1.7.6 remove prodigy -a codex -g -y
```

See: [Run any `npx skills` command](../guides/run-npx-skills-directly.md)

### `help`

Print the help to stdout. Aliases: `h`, `-h`, `--help`. An unknown command prints `unknown command: <name>` and the help to stderr, and exits with `1`.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills --help
```

```text
aiskills 0.3.0 — Sugato Ray's agent skills

Usage: aiskills <command> [options]
       ais <command> [options]     (same as aiskills)
       aix <command> [options]     (same as aiskills --route)

Commands:
  install, i     Save skills to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills and run 'npx skills add' on it (default)
  uninstall, r   Remove skills installed from ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills via 'npx skills remove' (also: rm, remove)
  installed, ls  Show skills currently installed from ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills
  groups, g      List skill groups (from .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) and their skills
  sync           Only save/refresh the skills folder; do not run 'npx skills add'
  list           List the skills available in the saved folder
  path, p        Print the folder that holds skills/
  find, f <q>    Search the skills registry (= npx skills find <query>)
  skills <args>  Pass <args> straight to 'npx skills'; ':root' is replaced by ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills
  help, h        Show this help

Scope/selection options (install, uninstall, installed):
  -g, --global           User-level (default)
  -p, --project          Current project instead of user-level
  -a, --agent <names>    Comma-separated agents (e.g. claude-code,codex); default: auto-detect
  -s, --skill <names>    Comma-separated skill names; default: all skills from this package
  -G, --group <names>    Comma-separated skill groups (e.g. scrolls-skills or just scrolls;
                         'all' = everything). Combines with -s. See 'aiskills groups'.
  -s/-G/-a may be repeated; values accumulate.
  -s/-G/-a accept glob patterns: * (any text), ? (one character), [abc] / [a-z] / [!a]
  (one of / range / not). Matching ignores case. A pattern that matches nothing is an
  error. Quote patterns so your shell doesn't expand them: -s 'scrolls-*'.

Routing (install, uninstall, installed; may also go before the command):
      --route            Hand skills that are NOT bundled to 'npx skills'.
                         The 'aix' command is 'aiskills --route' (e.g. 'aix i -s pdf'):
                           install:   -s <name>             -> npx skills find <name>, then add owner/repo@<name>
                                      -s owner/repo[@skill] -> npx skills add owner/repo[@skill] (also URLs/paths)
                           uninstall: -s <name|pattern>     -> also matches skills from other sources
                           installed: lists every installed skill with its source

Layout of ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (install, sync; may also go before the command):
      --flat             skills/<skill>/...          one folder per skill, as the npm package ships it
      --nested           skills/<group>/<skill>/...  the repo's original layout, incl. group READMEs etc.
                         The choice is remembered for later commands; default: flat. Either way,
                         'npx skills add' installs the same skills.

install only:
      --copy             Copy files into agent dirs instead of symlinking

uninstall only:
      --purge            Also delete ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills (only with a full uninstall)
  -f, --force            Allow -s names that this package does not provide
  -n, --dry-run          Print what would run; change nothing

Anything after '--' is appended to the underlying 'npx skills' command.

Examples:
  aiskills groups                             # what groups exist
  aiskills install --group scrolls --global --agent claude-code
  aiskills install -G scrolls,personas -s newsletter-ai -a claude-code,codex
  aiskills uninstall                          # remove every skill this package installed
  aiskills uninstall -G stata                 # remove one group
  aiskills install -G 'scroll*,d*' -a 'claude*,codex'
  aiskills install -s 'scrolls-*' -a 'cursor,qoder*'
  aiskills uninstall -s 'scrolls-[hu]*'       # scrolls-hide, -unhide, -update
  aiskills --route install -s scrolls-setup,pdf -a claude-code      # bundled + registry lookup
  aiskills install --route -s anthropics/skills@pdf -g              # external, pinned
  aiskills --route uninstall -s pdf                                 # remove an external skill
  aiskills --route installed                                        # bundled + external
  aiskills --nested                                                 # install, keeping the repo's nested folders
  aiskills uninstall -s scrolls-hide,prodigy  # remove just these
  aiskills uninstall -a codex                 # unlink from Codex only
  aiskills uninstall --purge                  # remove all, then delete ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills
  aiskills skills list -g                     # = npx skills list -g
  aiskills skills add :root -s prodigy -g -y  # = npx skills add ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills -s prodigy -g -y

Environment:
  AISKILLS_HOME          Override the install root (default ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills)
  AISKILLS_SCOPE, AISKILLS_AGENTS, AISKILLS_SKILLS, AISKILLS_GROUPS, AISKILLS_COPY
                         Defaults for the options above (also used by the npm postinstall)
  AISKILLS_ROUTE=1              Same as --route
  AISKILLS_LAYOUT=flat|nested   Same as --flat / --nested
  AISKILLS_SKIP_POSTINSTALL=1   Skip the npm postinstall hook entirely
  AISKILLS_SKIP_SKILLS_ADD=1    Postinstall copies files but skips 'npx skills add'
```

### `-v`, `--version`

Print the package version.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
ais -v
```

```text
0.3.0
```

## Options

Values for `-a`, `-s` and `-G` are comma-separated, may be [glob patterns](patterns.md), and accumulate when the option is repeated: `-s a,b` = `-s a -s b`. Options on the command line replace the matching [`AISKILLS_*`](environment.md) default.

| Option | install | uninstall | installed | groups | sync |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-g`, `-p` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | |
| `-a`, `-s`, `-G` | ✓ | ✓ | | | |
| `--route` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | |
| `--nested`, `--flat` | ✓ | | | | ✓ |
| `--copy` | ✓ | | | | |
| `--purge`, `-f`, `-n` | | ✓ | | | |
| `--json` | | | | ✓ | |
| `--` | ✓ | ✓ | | | |

### `-g`, `--global`

User-level scope: skills apply in every project. The default. Env: [`AISKILLS_SCOPE`](environment.md#aiskills_scope).

### `-p`, `--project`

Project scope: install, list or remove in the current folder. `npx skills` runs from the current folder without `--global`. Env: `AISKILLS_SCOPE=project`. See [3. Install into a project](../tutorial/03-install-into-a-project.md).

### `-a`, `--agent`

Agents to install to or remove from, e.g. `claude-code,codex`. Default: the agents `npx skills` detects (install) or every agent (uninstall). Plain names are passed to `npx skills`, which checks them. Patterns (`'claude*'`) are expanded against the agent list `npx skills` reports, and the result is printed as `agents: ...`. `-a '*'` is passed on as is, meaning all agents. Env: [`AISKILLS_AGENTS`](environment.md#aiskills_agents).

### `-s`, `--skill`

Skills, by name or pattern. Default: every skill. `-s '*'` is the same as no `-s`. Install matches against the bundled skills; uninstall also against the skills installed from the install folder. A name that isn't bundled is refused unless [`--route`](#--route) (or `-f` on uninstall). With `--route`, `-s` also takes `owner/repo@skill`, `owner/repo`, URLs and paths. Env: [`AISKILLS_SKILLS`](environment.md#aiskills_skills).

### `-G`, `--group`, `--groups`

Skill groups, by name (`scrolls-skills`), alias (`scrolls`), pattern, or `all`. Combines with `-s` (union). See [Skill groups](../concepts/skill-groups.md). Env: [`AISKILLS_GROUPS`](environment.md#aiskills_groups).

### `--route`

Hand skills that aren't bundled to `npx skills`: look up bare names with `npx skills find` (install only on a unique exact match), pass `owner/repo@skill` and other sources to `npx skills add`, let uninstall match any source, and make `installed` list every skill with its source. The `aix` command always sets it. Env: [`AISKILLS_ROUTE`](environment.md#aiskills_route). See [Bundled and external skills](../concepts/bundled-and-external.md).

### `--nested`

Write `<install folder>/skills/` in the repo's nested layout. Remembered for later commands. Env: [`AISKILLS_LAYOUT`](environment.md#aiskills_layout). See [Layouts](../concepts/layouts.md).

### `--flat`

Write `<install folder>/skills/` flat, one folder per skill (the default). Remembered for later commands.

### `--copy`

Pass `--copy` to `npx skills add`: copy the files into agent folders instead of symlinking them. Env: [`AISKILLS_COPY`](environment.md#aiskills_copy).

### `--purge`

After a full uninstall, delete the install folder. Refused with `-s`/`-G`, and refused for a folder that isn't an aiskills folder (checked before anything is removed).

### `-f`, `--force`

On uninstall, pass `-s` names to `npx skills remove` even if this package doesn't provide them.

### `-n`, `--dry-run`

On uninstall, print what would be removed and the exact `npx skills` command, and change nothing.

### `--json`

On `groups`, print the groups as JSON. Schema: [Files and schemas](files.md#aiskills-groups---json).

### `--`

Everything after `--` is appended to the `npx skills add` (install) or `npx skills remove` (uninstall) command. See [Run any `npx skills` command](../guides/run-npx-skills-directly.md#extra-flags-on-install-and-uninstall).

See also: [Environment variables](environment.md) · [Errors and exit codes](errors.md) · [Patterns](patterns.md)

<!-- source: reference/patterns.md -->
# Patterns reference

The glob syntax that `-s`, `-G` and `-a` accept (and `AISKILLS_SKILLS`, `AISKILLS_GROUPS`, `AISKILLS_AGENTS`), on install and uninstall; this page is exhaustive.

## Syntax

| Pattern | Matches | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `*` | Any text, including none | `scrolls-*` |
| `?` | Exactly one character | `?????-recipes` |
| `[abc]` | One of the listed characters | `scrolls-[hu]*` → scrolls-help, -hide, -unhide, -update |
| `[a-z]` | One character in the range | `scrolls-[r-u]*` |
| `[!abc]`, `[^abc]` | One character **not** listed | `scrolls-[!hu]*` → scrolls-remove, -restore, -setup |

Any other character matches itself. An entry with none of `*`, `?` or `[` is a plain name.

## Rules

- **Case is ignored**, for patterns and plain names alike.
- **The whole name must match.** `scroll*` matches `scrolls-skills`; `croll` matches nothing.
- **Mix freely.** One comma-separated list can hold names and patterns: `-s 'scrolls-*,prodigy'`.
- **A pattern that matches nothing is an error**, before anything changes. The message lists what is available.
- **Quote patterns** (`'scrolls-*'`), or your shell may expand them into file names.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills install -s '?????-recipes' -a claude-code
```

```text
[aiskills] skills saved to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (flat layout)
[aiskills] bundled: stata-recipes
[aiskills] running: npx -y skills@1.7.6 add ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills --global --skill stata-recipes --agent claude-code --yes
```

## What each option matches against

| Option | Matched against |
| --- | --- |
| `-s`, `--skill` | **install:** the bundled skills. **uninstall:** the bundled skills plus the skills installed from the install folder; with `--route`, every installed skill. |
| `-G`, `--group` | Group names **and** aliases. `all` and `*` mean every bundled skill. |
| `-a`, `--agent` | The agent ids `npx skills` accepts (`claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor`, …), read from `npx skills` itself. |

## Special cases

### `-s '*'`

Every skill, the same as no `-s`.

### `-a '*'`

Passed to `npx skills` unchanged; it means all agents.

### Plain agent names

Not checked by `aiskills`; `npx skills` checks them. Only patterns are expanded, and the expansion is printed as `[aiskills] agents: ...`.

### Uninstall with a pattern or a group

Only skills that are actually installed are removed. Plain names are always passed on with `-f`.

### `--route` and patterns

Patterns match only bundled (or, on uninstall, installed) skills. The registry can't be searched by pattern: use `aiskills find <query>`.

See also: [CLI reference](cli.md) · [2. Pick skills and agents](../tutorial/02-pick-skills-and-agents.md)

<!-- source: reference/environment.md -->
# Environment variables reference

Every environment variable `aiskills` and its npm install step read; this page is exhaustive.

Variables give defaults. An option on the command line replaces the matching variable. The npm install step (`postinstall`) takes no options, so it reads only these. Values that are lists are comma-separated, and accept [patterns](patterns.md). "Truthy" means `1`, `true` or `yes`, in any case.

<!-- verify -->
```bash
AISKILLS_LAYOUT=nested aiskills sync
```

```text
[aiskills] skills saved to ~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills (nested layout)
```

## Choosing skills and agents

### `AISKILLS_SKILLS`

Default for `-s`: skill names or patterns. Unset: every skill. In the install step, a name that isn't bundled is an error unless [`AISKILLS_ROUTE`](#aiskills_route) is truthy.

### `AISKILLS_GROUPS`

Default for `-G`: group names, aliases or patterns. Combined with `AISKILLS_SKILLS` (union).

### `AISKILLS_AGENTS`

Default for `-a`: agent names or patterns. Unset: the agents `npx skills` detects.

### `AISKILLS_SCOPE`

`project` = `-p`; anything else, or unset, = `-g` (global).

### `AISKILLS_COPY`

Truthy = `--copy`.

### `AISKILLS_ROUTE`

Truthy = `--route`. The `aix` command sets it. In the install step, lets names in `AISKILLS_SKILLS` that aren't bundled be looked up.

### `AISKILLS_LAYOUT`

`flat` or `nested`, the same as `--flat` / `--nested`. A command-line flag wins over it; it wins over the remembered layout. Any other value fails with `unknown layout`.

## Where things go

### `AISKILLS_HOME`

The install folder. Default: `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills`. A relative path is resolved from the current folder. If the folder exists, it must be empty or an aiskills folder (it has `aiskills.json`); otherwise `aiskills` refuses to replace or delete it.

### `AISKILLS_SKILLS_VERSION`

The `skills` CLI version every `npx` call runs. Default: `1.7.6` (pinned and tested). Accepts an exact version (`1.7.6`, `1.8.0-beta.1`), `latest` or `next`; anything else is refused. See [Choose the `skills` CLI version](../guides/choose-the-skills-cli-version.md).

## The npm install step

### `AISKILLS_SKIP_POSTINSTALL`

Truthy: the install step does nothing. Same effect as `npm install --ignore-scripts` for this package.

### `AISKILLS_SKIP_SKILLS_ADD`

Truthy: the install step saves the skills to the install folder but doesn't run `npx skills add`.

### `CI`

Truthy (most CI systems set `CI=true`): same as `AISKILLS_SKIP_SKILLS_ADD`. Only the install step reads it; `aiskills install` in CI still installs.

### `INIT_CWD`

Set by npm to the folder `npm install` was run from. With `AISKILLS_SCOPE=project`, the install step installs into that folder.

## Read by `npx skills`, passed through

`aiskills` passes every variable to `npx` except npm's own `npm_*` variables (registry, proxy and certificate settings among them are kept). These are worth knowing:

| Variable | Effect in `npx skills` |
| --- | --- |
| `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, `DO_NOT_TRACK` | Turn off its anonymous usage data to `skills.sh` |

See also: [Configure the npm install step](../guides/configure-npm-install.md) · [CLI reference](cli.md)

<!-- source: reference/files.md -->
# Files and schemas reference

What `aiskills` writes and where, and the exact fields of every file and JSON output it produces or reads; this page is exhaustive.

## The install folder

`~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/` (or [`AISKILLS_HOME`](environment.md#aiskills_home)), written by every sync (`install`, `sync`, `list`, `groups` and the npm install step):

```text
~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/
├── aiskills.json                     marks the folder as an aiskills folder; last sync
├── skills/                           the skills, flat or nested; replaced on every sync
├── .aiskills/layout.json             each skill's original folder
└── .claude-plugin/marketplace.json   the repo's marketplace file, used for groups
```

`skills/` is built in a temporary `.skills.tmp-<pid>` folder next to it, then swapped in.

## `aiskills.json`

```json
{
  "package": "@sugatoray-ai/aiskills",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "layout": "flat",
  "installedAt": "2026-11-06T10:26:01.152Z",
  "skills": "/home/me/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills"
}
```

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `package` | string | Always `@sugatoray-ai/aiskills`. Its presence is what makes a folder safe for `aiskills` to replace or delete. |
| `version` | string | The package version that wrote the folder. |
| `layout` | `"flat"` \| `"nested"` | The layout of `skills/`, reused by the next sync unless overridden. |
| `installedAt` | string (ISO 8601) | When the folder was last synced. |
| `skills` | string (absolute path) | The `skills/` folder. |

## `.aiskills/layout.json`

Written when the package is built, and copied to the install folder.

```json
{
  "format": 1,
  "description": "skills/ is flat (skills/<name>/). …",
  "skills": {
    "create-lib-docs": "docs/create-lib-docs",
    "scrolls-setup": "scrolls/scrolls-setup"
  },
  "extras": ["scrolls/README.md", "scrolls/.claude-plugin/plugin.json"],
  "ignored": []
}
```

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | number | Version of this file's shape; currently `1`. |
| `description` | string | A note for people reading the file. |
| `skills` | object: skill name → string | Each skill's original folder, relative to the repo's `skills/`. Used for `--nested` and for groups. |
| `extras` | string[] | Files outside any skill folder (READMEs, `plugin.json`, `meta/`), stored in the package under `.aiskills/nested/` at these paths. |
| `ignored` | string[] | Paths a `.skillsignore` left out of the package. Folders end with `/`. |

## The package

```text
@sugatoray-ai/aiskills/
├── bin/aiskills.mjs, bin/aix.mjs     the commands (aiskills and ais share one file)
├── src/scripts/core/                 cli.mjs, installer.mjs, postinstall.mjs
├── skills/<skill>/                   the skills, flat
├── .aiskills/layout.json, .aiskills/nested/
├── .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
└── README.md, CHANGELOG.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, package.json
```

Files named `.gitignore` and `.npmignore` inside the skills are stored as `_gitignore` and `_npmignore`, because npm drops the real names; every sync renames them back. The package has no JavaScript API: only the commands are public.

## `aiskills groups --json`

```json
{
  "groups": [
    {
      "name": "scrolls-skills",
      "alias": "scrolls",
      "description": "Scrolls: a git-native markdown system …",
      "skills": ["scrolls-help", "scrolls-hide", "…"]
    }
  ],
  "ungrouped": ["newsletter-ai"]
}
```

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `groups[].name` | string | The group name from `marketplace.json`. |
| `groups[].alias` | string | The name without a trailing `-skills`. |
| `groups[].description` | string | From `marketplace.json`; may be empty. |
| `groups[].skills` | string[] | Skill names, sorted. |
| `ungrouped` | string[] | Bundled skills in no group, sorted. |

## `npx skills list --json` rows

`aiskills` reads these (from `npx skills list --json [--global]`) to know what is installed. It never writes them. Fields as reported by `skills@1.7.6`:

| Field | Type | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | The skill name. |
| `source` | string | Where it was installed from: a folder path, or `owner/repo`. |
| `sourceType` | string | `local` for a folder, `github` for GitHub. |
| `scope` | string | `global` or `project`. |
| `agents` | string[] | Agents it's installed for, as display names such as `Claude Code` (shown by `installed`). |
| `path`, `sourceUrl`, `status` | string | Also present in `skills@1.7.6`; not used by `aiskills`. |

A row is **from this package** when `sourceType` is `local` and `source` is the install folder.

## Written by `npx skills`

The agents' skill folders (`~/.claude/skills/`, `~/.agents/skills/`, …, or the project's with `-p`) and `npx skills`' own records, such as a project's `skills-lock.json`. `aiskills` doesn't touch them directly.

See also: [How aiskills works](../concepts/how-it-works.md) · [Layouts](../concepts/layouts.md)

<!-- source: reference/skillsignore.md -->
# `.skillsignore` reference

The rule syntax of `.skillsignore` files, which leave files, folders or whole skills out of the package when it is built; this page is exhaustive.

A `.skillsignore` can sit in the repo's `skills/` folder or any folder below it. Its rules apply to that folder and below. It is read only when the package is built (`npm pack`), so it matters to maintainers, not to users.

## Syntax

The syntax is a subset of `.gitignore`:

| Line | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| blank, or starting with `#` | Skipped. A `#` later in a line is part of the pattern. |
| `\#name`, `\!name` | A literal leading `#` or `!`. |
| `name` | A file or folder with that name, at any depth. |
| `/name`, `a/name` | A leading or middle `/` anchors the pattern to the `.skillsignore`'s folder. |
| `name/` | Folders only. |
| `*`, `?`, `[abc]`, `[!abc]` | Within one path segment. |
| `**` | Across segments: `**/x`, `x/**`, `a/**/b`. |
| `!pattern` | Re-include something an earlier rule excluded. |

## Rules

- **The last matching rule wins.** Rules in a deeper `.skillsignore` come after the outer ones.
- **An ignored folder is never entered**, so a file inside it can't be re-included (as in git).
- **`.skillsignore` files never ship.**
- **Ignoring only a `SKILL.md` is refused.** Ignore the skill's folder to drop the skill.
- **What was left out** is listed under `ignored` in [`.aiskills/layout.json`](files.md#aiskillslayoutjson).

## Example

```gitignore
# every tests/ folder, at any depth
**/tests/
# a "/" in the middle anchors to this folder, so use **/ for any depth
**/meta/MAINTAINERS.md
# all .log files except keep.log
*.log
!keep.log
# ignoring a skill's folder drops the whole skill
scrolls/wip-skill/
```

See also: [Leave files out of the package](../guides/leave-files-out.md) · [Errors](errors.md#packaging-errors-maintainers)

<!-- source: reference/errors.md -->
# Errors and exit codes reference

Every error and warning `aiskills` prints, with its cause and fix, and what each exit code means; this page is exhaustive.

Errors and warnings go to stderr and start with `[aiskills]`. Parts in `<angle brackets>` vary.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | Success. `uninstall` also exits `0` when there was nothing to remove. |
| `1` | `aiskills` stopped with one of the errors below, or `installed` couldn't read `npx skills list`. No skill was installed or removed. |
| any other | The exit code of the `npx skills` command it ran, passed through. |

The npm install step always exits `0`, so that `npm install` never fails because of it. Its problems are printed as [warnings](#install-step-warnings).

<!-- verify -->
```bash
aiskills install --purge
```

```text
[aiskills] option --purge is not valid here
```

## Options and commands

### Option not valid here

```text
[aiskills] option <option> is not valid here
```

**Cause:** the option exists, but not for this command, e.g. `--purge` on `install`. **Fix:** see which options each command takes in the [CLI reference](cli.md#options).

### Unknown option

```text
[aiskills] unknown option: <option>
```

**Cause:** a typo, or an option of `npx skills` given directly. **Fix:** check `aiskills --help`; pass `npx skills` options after `--`.

### Option needs a value

```text
[aiskills] <option> needs a value
```

**Cause:** `-a`, `-s` or `-G` is the last argument. **Fix:** add the value: `-s scrolls-setup`.

### Unknown command

```text
unknown command: <name>
```

**Cause:** not one of the [commands](cli.md#commands). The help follows on stderr. **Fix:** check the spelling; `aiskills help` lists them.

## Choosing skills, groups and agents

### Not provided by this package

```text
[aiskills] not provided by this package: <names>
  available: <bundled skills>
  add --route to look them up with 'npx skills' instead
```

**Cause:** `install -s` names a skill that isn't bundled. **Fix:** check the spelling against `available`, or add `--route` (or use `aix`) for an external skill. On `uninstall` the last line reads `use --route to also match skills installed from other sources, or -f/--force`.

### No skill matches

```text
[aiskills] no skill matches: <patterns>
  available: <skills>
```

**Cause:** an `-s` pattern matched no skill. **Fix:** adjust the pattern; patterns match the whole name, ignoring case.

### No group matches

```text
[aiskills] no group matches: <names>
  available: <group (alias), …>, all
  see 'aiskills groups'
```

**Cause:** a `-G` name, alias or pattern matched no group. **Fix:** pick one from `available`.

### The selected groups contain no skills

```text
[aiskills] the selected group(s) contain no skills
```

**Cause:** the `-G` groups exist but have no bundled skills. **Fix:** choose other groups; `aiskills groups` shows each group's skills.

### No marketplace.json

```text
[aiskills] no .claude-plugin/marketplace.json in <install folder>; run 'aiskills sync' first
```

**Cause:** `-G` was used but the install folder has no `marketplace.json`, e.g. it was synced by an older version. **Fix:** `aiskills sync`.

### No agent matches

```text
[aiskills] no agent matches: <patterns>
  valid agents: <agents>
```

**Cause:** an `-a` pattern matched none of the agents `npx skills` supports. **Fix:** adjust the pattern, or use names from `valid agents`.

### Could not read the agent list

```text
[aiskills] could not read the agent list from 'npx skills'
```

**Cause:** an `-a` pattern needs the agent list, and `npx skills` didn't print it (no network for the first download, or a `skills` version that words it differently). **Fix:** pass plain agent names instead of a pattern, or go back to the pinned `skills` version.

## Uninstall

### Purge only with a full uninstall

```text
[aiskills] --purge only applies to a full uninstall (drop -s/-G)
```

**Cause:** `--purge` with `-s` or `-G`. **Fix:** remove the skills first, then run `aiskills uninstall --purge` on its own.

### Names a source, not a skill

```text
[aiskills] '<entry>' names a source, not a skill; use -s <skill> or <owner/repo@skill>
```

**Cause:** `--route uninstall -s owner/repo`: a repository isn't a skill name. **Fix:** name the skill, `-s pdf` or `-s owner/repo@pdf`.

### Not installed, skipping

```text
[aiskills] not installed (<scope>), skipping: <names>
```

**Warning.** **Cause:** with `--route`, these names aren't installed in this scope. **Fix:** none needed; check `-g`/`-p` if you expected them.

### Could not read `npx skills list` (uninstall)

```text
[aiskills] could not read 'npx skills list'; falling back to the skills found in <install folder>
```

**Warning.** **Cause:** `npx skills list --json` failed during a full uninstall, so `aiskills` removes every skill name in its folder instead. **Fix:** usually none; check network access if it repeats.

### Could not read `npx skills list` (installed)

```text
[aiskills] could not read 'npx skills list'
```

**Cause:** `installed` couldn't run or parse `npx skills list --json`; exit code `1`. **Fix:** run `aiskills skills list -g` to see the underlying error.

## External skills (`--route`)

### Matches several skills

```text
[aiskills] '<name>' matches several skills; pick one with -s <owner/repo@skill>:
    <owner/repo@name>  (<installs>)
    …
```

**Cause:** more than one registry result has exactly this name. `aiskills` never picks. **Fix:** choose one and pass it as `-s owner/repo@name`.

### No skill named exactly

```text
[aiskills] no skill named exactly '<name>'; closest results:
    <owner/repo@skill>  (<installs>)
```

**Cause:** the registry has similar skills but none with this exact name. **Fix:** use one of the listed names, or `aiskills find <query>` to search.

### No skill found

```text
[aiskills] no skill named '<name>' found by 'npx skills find'
```

**Cause:** the registry returned nothing (or there's no network access to `skills.sh`). **Fix:** check the name and network, or give the source as `owner/repo@skill`.

### Unsafe registry results ignored

```text
[aiskills] ignored <n> registry result(s) with unsafe characters: "<spec>", …
```

**Warning.** **Cause:** results whose `owner/repo@skill` has characters other than letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` are never used. **Fix:** none needed. If the skill you want was among them, check its source and pass it yourself.

## Files and folders

### Not an aiskills folder

```text
[aiskills] <folder> is not an aiskills folder (it has other files but no aiskills.json), so it won't be replaced or deleted.
  Point AISKILLS_HOME at a new or empty folder instead.
```

**Cause:** the install folder (usually from `AISKILLS_HOME`) already holds files that `aiskills` didn't write. **Fix:** point `AISKILLS_HOME` at a new or empty folder, or unset it.

### Unknown layout

```text
[aiskills] unknown layout '<value>' (use flat or nested)
```

**Cause:** `AISKILLS_LAYOUT`, or the `layout` in `aiskills.json`, isn't `flat` or `nested`. **Fix:** set `AISKILLS_LAYOUT=flat` or `nested`, or run `aiskills sync --flat`.

### No vendored skills folder

```text
[aiskills] no vendored skills folder at <package>/skills
```

**Cause:** the package has no `skills/`, which happens when running from a git checkout of the repo. **Fix:** install the published package, or run `npm run vendor` in the checkout.

### Nested layout unavailable

```text
[aiskills] this package has no .aiskills/layout.json, so --nested can't rebuild the nested layout
```

**Cause:** the package was built without `layout.json`. **Fix:** use `--flat`, or reinstall the published package.

## Running `npx skills`

### Bad `AISKILLS_SKILLS_VERSION`

```text
[aiskills] AISKILLS_SKILLS_VERSION must be an exact version (e.g. 1.7.6), "latest" or "next"; got '<value>'
```

**Cause:** ranges, tags other than `latest`/`next`, and other text are refused. **Fix:** use an exact version, or unset it for the pinned one.

### Shell characters on Windows

```text
[aiskills] refusing to pass shell characters to cmd.exe: <arguments>
```

**Cause:** on Windows, an argument contains one of `& | < > ^ % ! " ( )`, which `cmd.exe` would interpret. **Fix:** remove those characters; skill names and specs never need them.

## Install step warnings

The npm install step prints these and still lets `npm install` succeed.

### Unknown skills in `AISKILLS_SKILLS`

```text
[aiskills] postinstall did not complete: unknown skill(s) in AISKILLS_SKILLS: <names> (set AISKILLS_ROUTE=1 to look them up)
[aiskills] run 'npx aiskills install' to retry.
```

**Cause:** a name in `AISKILLS_SKILLS` isn't bundled. **Fix:** fix the name, or set `AISKILLS_ROUTE=1`.

### Install step didn't complete

```text
[aiskills] postinstall did not complete: <error>
[aiskills] run 'npx aiskills install' to retry.
```

**Cause:** any of the errors on this page, raised during the install step. **Fix:** run `aiskills install` with the same choices to see and fix it.

### `npx skills add` failed

```text
[aiskills] 'npx skills add' exited with <code>. Skills are saved in <install folder>/skills;
[aiskills] register them later with:  npx skills add <install folder> --global
```

**Cause:** `npx skills add` failed (often no network access). The skills are on disk. **Fix:** run `aiskills install` when it can reach the registry.

## Packaging errors (maintainers)

These come from `npm pack` / `npm run vendor`, when the package is built from the repo.

### Repo not found

```text
no ancestor of <folder> contains skills/ and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
```

**Fix:** build from inside the repo, where `skills/` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` are above the package folder.

### `skills/` not found

```text
<repo>/skills not found
```

**Fix:** the repo's `skills/` folder is missing; restore it.

### SKILL.md ignored

```text
.skillsignore ignores <group>/<skill>/SKILL.md; to drop a skill, ignore the folder (<group>/<skill>/) instead
```

**Fix:** ignore the skill's folder, not only its `SKILL.md`. See [`.skillsignore`](skillsignore.md).

### Skill directly in `skills/`

```text
<repo>/skills/SKILL.md: a skill can't sit directly in skills/
```

**Fix:** move the skill into its own folder.

### Skill inside a skill

```text
skills inside other skills aren't supported: <folders>
```

**Fix:** move the inner skill out to its own folder.

### Unsafe skill name

```text
skills/<folder>: skill name '<name>' can't be used as a folder name
```

**Fix:** use only letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` in the `name:`.

### Duplicate skill name

```text
two skills are both named '<name>': skills/<folder> and skills/<folder>
```

**Fix:** give one of them another `name:`.

## Docs build errors (maintainers)

These come from `npm run docs:html`, which builds `docs/docsite/index.html`.

### Page not in the landing page

```text
pages not linked from a section of README.md: <pages>
```

**Fix:** add each page to a `### Section` list in `docs/docsite/README.md` (`- [Title](path.md): summary`). The tabs are built from those lists.

### Usage

```text
usage: build-docs-html.mjs <docs-dir> --out <file.html> [--ref <branch>]
```

**Fix:** pass the docs folder and `--out`, or use `npm run docs:html`.

## Banner build errors (maintainers)

These come from `npm run banner`, `banner:check` and `banner:png` (`src/scripts/docs/create-banner.mjs`), and from `npm run docs:html`, which copies the banner onto the docs landing page.

### Config value not quoted

```text
config line <n>: values must be double-quoted strings: <text>
```

**Fix:** in `docs/banner/config.yaml`, write every value as `key: "value"`, and list items as `  - "item"`.

### Config line not understood

```text
config line <n>: expected 'key: "value"' or a '  - "item"' line
config line <n>: a list item without a key above it
```

**Fix:** use only `key: "value"`, `key:` followed by `  - "item"` lines, blank lines and `#` comments.

### Unknown `--set` key

```text
--set: unknown key: <key>
```

**Fix:** use a key that exists in `config.yaml`.

### Install style or count

```text
install_style must be "box" or "chips", not "<value>"
install_style "<style>" has room for 1 to <max> install commands, not <n>
```

**Fix:** `box` takes up to 3 commands and `chips` up to 2.

### Unknown theme

```text
unknown theme: <name> (use one of teal, paper, phosphor, …, lightsout)
```

**Fix:** set `theme` in `docs/banner/config.yaml` (or `--set theme=…`) to one of the themes in `src/scripts/docs/themes.mjs`. The default is `lightsout`.

### Demo group or skill

```text
demo_group "<name>" isn't a bundled group (<aliases>)
route_skill "<name>" is bundled, so 'aix i -s <name>' wouldn't look it up
```

**Fix:** `demo_group` must be a bundled group; `route_skill` must be a skill the package does *not* bundle, or the terminal demo would show something `aiskills` doesn't do.

### Template placeholder without a value

```text
template placeholder {{ <name> }} has no value
```

**Fix:** a placeholder was added to `src/scripts/docs/templates/banner-template.html` without a value in `render()`; add one.

### PNG needs Playwright

```text
--png needs Playwright (npm install -g playwright, then npx playwright install chromium)
--scale must be 1, 2 or 4
```

**Fix:** install Playwright and Chromium, and use scale 1, 2 or 4.

### Page out of date

```text
<path>/aiskills-banner.html is out of date: run npm run banner
```

**Fix:** run `npm run banner` (and `npm run banner:png` for the README image), then `npm run docs:html`.

### Banner page missing (docs build)

```text
banner page not found: <path> (run npm run banner, or pass --no-banner)
<path>: no banner:html:start ... banner:html:end markers
```

**Fix:** build the banner page first, or build the docs with `--no-banner`. Keep the `banner:html` and `banner:css` marker comments in the template.

See also: [Use aiskills from an AI agent or a script](../guides/use-from-an-agent.md) · [FAQ and troubleshooting](../faq.md)

<!-- source: faq.md -->
# FAQ and troubleshooting

Answers to the questions people ask most, and fixes for the problems they hit.

## Questions

### Which agents are supported?

Every agent the `skills` CLI supports: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Qoder and many more. `aiskills` reads the list from `npx skills`, so a newer `skills` version brings new agents with no change here. Pass agent ids to `-a` (`claude-code`, `codex`, `cursor`, …).

### Where are the skills on my machine?

The saved copy is in `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills/` (`aiskills path` prints the folder). `npx skills` installs them into each agent's own folder, such as `~/.claude/skills/`, or the project's folders with `-p`.

### What's the difference between `aiskills`, `ais` and `aix`?

`ais` is `aiskills`. `aix` is `aiskills --route`, which also manages skills that aren't bundled. See [Bundled and external skills](concepts/bundled-and-external.md).

### How do I update the skills?

Install a newer package: `npm install -g @sugatoray-ai/aiskills@latest`. The install step saves the new skills and registers them again. If you had picked particular skills or agents, run that `aiskills install ...` command again.

### Does it install Claude Code plugins?

No. It reads the repo's `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` only to group the skills. Everything is installed as skills through `npx skills`.

### Can I edit the saved skills?

Don't: every sync replaces `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills/`. Copy a skill elsewhere to change it, or contribute the change to [the repo](https://github.com/sugatoray/aiskills).

### Does aiskills send any data?

No. The `skills` CLI it runs sends anonymous usage data to `skills.sh` unless `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` is set. See [Security model](concepts/security.md#telemetry).

### How do I change how these docs look?

In the single-page HTML version of these docs (`index.html`), click the gear at the top right and pick one of 11 themes; the moon/sun button next to it switches light and dark. Your choice is remembered in your browser. The default is Lights Out.

### Is there a JavaScript API?

No. Only the commands are public; the files under `src/scripts/core/` can change in any release.

### What is a skill group, and why is `newsletter-ai` "ungrouped"?

Groups come from the plugin entries in the repo's `marketplace.json`. `newsletter-ai` isn't in any entry, so install it by name or with `-G all`. See [Skill groups](concepts/skill-groups.md).

## Troubleshooting

### Nothing was installed by `npm install -g`

- **Symptom:** `aiskills installed` shows nothing after the npm install.
- **Cause:** the install step hides its output and never fails. It may have been skipped (`--ignore-scripts`, pnpm, bun, `CI` set) or `npx skills add` may have failed (offline, proxy).
- **Fix:** run `aiskills install`. It prints what goes wrong.

### `skills: not found` during the npm install

- **Cause:** an npm setting reached the nested `npx`. `aiskills` removes npm's own variables before running `npx`, so this means a new one got through.
- **Fix:** run `aiskills install` after the npm install, and please [report it](https://github.com/sugatoray/aiskills/issues).

### A pattern does nothing, or matches files

- **Cause:** the shell expanded an unquoted pattern, such as `-s scrolls-*`, into file names.
- **Fix:** quote it: `-s 'scrolls-*'`.

### A skill's `.gitignore` is missing in the package

- **Cause:** npm drops files named `.gitignore`. The package stores them as `_gitignore`.
- **Fix:** none needed: every sync renames them back in `~/.config/sugatoray/aiskills/skills/`.

### `--route` can't find a skill I know exists

- **Cause:** the name isn't an exact match, several skills share it, or there's no network access to `skills.sh`.
- **Fix:** run `aiskills find <name>` and pass the exact `owner/repo@skill`. See [Errors](reference/errors.md#external-skills---route).

### `... is not an aiskills folder ...`

- **Cause:** `AISKILLS_HOME` points at a folder with other files in it, which `aiskills` refuses to replace or delete.
- **Fix:** point it at a new or empty folder. See [Errors](reference/errors.md#not-an-aiskills-folder).

### `aiskills` is gone, but the skills are still installed

- **Cause:** npm ran no step on `npm uninstall -g`.
- **Fix:** `npx @sugatoray-ai/aiskills uninstall --purge`. See [Remove everything](guides/remove-everything.md).

See also: [Errors and exit codes](reference/errors.md) · [Docs home](README.md)
